{{Dialogue|Rex|What do you think of our little ''Padawan'' now?|Sarge|<nowiki></nowiki>''Padawan&mdash;?!?'' I don't see any ''Padawan''.|Gunner|To us she's a ''Jedi Knight'' already, sir.|attr=Rex, Sarge, and Gunner|src=<ref name="Night Moves" />}}
'''Gunner''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who participated in the [[Battle of Zeenada]] under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Gunner served alongside fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Sarge (clone trooper)|Sarge]].<ref name="Night Moves" />
